name: an ObjectStore alone
code: import { ObjectStore } from '@reely/simple-store'; new ObjectStore({ lap: 0 }).set({ lap: 1 });

name: both stores and an emitter
code: import { EventEmitter } from '@reely/emitter'; import { ObjectStore, PrimitiveStore } from '@reely/simple-store'; new EventEmitter().emit('lap'); new ObjectStore({ lap: 0 }).set({ lap: 1 }); new PrimitiveStore(0).value = 1;
